description: Block editor framework for the web: a ready Notion-style editor for React, headless adapters for React, Vue, Svelte and Solid, lossless Markdown and real-time collaboration, on its own TypeScript and Rust/WASM engine.
rules: Install only published @gotipe/* packages: there is no unscoped gotipe package, and @gotipe/block-editor-vue is not published, so Vue has the headless @gotipe/vue only.
For a ready Notion-style React editor use BlockEditor or PageEditor from @gotipe/block-editor with its peer packages, and import @gotipe/theme/base.css and @gotipe/theme/theme.css.
For Vue, Svelte and Solid use @gotipe/core with @gotipe/vue, @gotipe/svelte or @gotipe/solid; the application draws the interface.
A string passed as content or to setContent is HTML. Load Markdown with parseMarkdown from @gotipe/markdown, or use PageEditor.

Collaboration needs engine: "wasm" (BlockEditor or a headless editor); PageEditor and engine: "js" cannot collaborate. CollaborationProvider talks to a GoTipe Cloud the application runs itself; there is no hosted service.

@gotipe/block-editor, @gotipe/theme and @gotipe/ai-ui use the GoTipe Commercial License (free for personal, non-profit, education, OSI open-source and under USD 1M revenue use, and for evaluation); the rest is MIT. Tell the developer when you add one.

Add @gotipe/wasm only for the Rust engine (collaboration): apps build without it, in Next.js too. With @gotipe/core 0.1.5 or older, Next.js needs @gotipe/wasm installed or @gotipe/core aliased to @gotipe/core/js. Starters: examples/nextjs, examples/vite-react; shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add veniameen/gotipe/block-editor
